blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current explanation methods for contrastive vision–language models such as CLIP mainly identify important regions without showing how to change the input in order to get a target prediction. We introduce M ask-guided A daptive C ounterfactual E xplanations (MACE), a targeted visual counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. MACE constructs an editable region from either source attribution or source–target attribution differences and expands the mask only when needed to reach a specified target class. A latent diffusion inpainting model then modifies the selected region, while a frozen CLIP model provides modification guidance and anchors the remaining image content to the original input. We evaluate MACE on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200. The source-mask variant achieves the highest target top-1 success rate across all four datasets, while the difference-mask variant produces the smallest pixel-level and perceptual changes and the best realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over a Stable Diffusion-only baseline using the same generative backbone. These results show that adaptive mask-guided editing produces effective CLIP counterfactuals. They further reveal a tradeoff between counterfactual validity and source-image preservation. The source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MACE-04BC/ .
blocks.zh: 目前对比视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)的解释方法主要识别出重要区域,而没有显示如何改变输入以获得目标预测. 我们引入了M ask-guided A daptive C unterfact E xplainments(MACE),这是一种专门针对CLIP零发分级设计的定向视觉反事实方法. MACE 构建一个来自源属性或源-目标属性差异的可编辑区域,并只在需要达到指定目标类别时才扩展掩码. 一个潜在的扩散涂抹模型然后会修改所选区域,而被冻结的CLIP模型则提供修改指导并固定剩余图像内容到原始输入. 我们在ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets和CUB-200上评价MACE。 源-mask变相在所有四个数据集中都实现了最高的目标上-1成功率,而差-mask变相则产生最小的像素水平和知觉变化和最佳现实主义分数. 这两种变体都使用同一种基因主干线,在稳定扩散的唯一基线上改进了接近性和现实性。 这些结果显示适应性的口罩制导编辑产生了有效的CLIP反事实. 他们进一步揭示了反事实有效性和源图像保存之间的取舍。 源代码见https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MACE-04BC/.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: CLIP [ 28 ] is widely used for zero-shot classification [ 31 , 22 , 26 ] , retrieval [ 27 , 39 , 30 ] , and multimodal applications ranging from safety inspection [ 34 , 25 ] to decision support [ 45 ] . However, CLIP explanations remain dominated by attention and gradient maps, which highlight relevant regions without showing how the input must change to alter the prediction [ 19 , 44 , 21 ] . Counterfactual explanations address this limitation by identifying a small, meaningful change that produces a different model outcome [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh: CLIP [28]被广泛用于零发分级[31,22,26],检索[27,39,30],以及从安全检查[34,25]到决定支持[45]的多式应用. 然而,CLIP的解释仍然以注意和梯度图为主,图中突出相关区域,但没有说明投入必须如何改变以改变预测[19,44,21]. 反事实解释通过确定产生不同模式结果的有实际意义的小变化来解决这一限制。

blocks.en: Existing visual counterfactual methods mainly target conventional classifiers and optimize class logits or probabilities [ 10 , 5 , 1 ] . CLIP-guided editing methods instead optimize alignment with a target prompt [ 40 , 9 ] , but prompt alignment does not ensure that the target becomes the top prediction within the full zero-shot class set. These methods also do not necessarily produce the smallest localized edit responsible for the decision change.
blocks.zh: 现有的视觉反事实方法主要针对常规分类器并优化类对数或概率[10,5,1]. CLIP-制导的编辑方法取而代之,优化了与目标即时[40,9]的对接,但即时对接并不能确保目标成为全零镜头类集内的最高预测. 这些方法也不一定产生最小的本地化编辑来负责决定的改变.

blocks.en: We therefore propose M ask-guided A daptive C ounterfactual E xplanations (MACE) (overview in Fig. 1 ), a method for targeted visual counterfactual explanations of CLIP zero-shot predictions. To our knowledge, MACE is the first image-level counterfactual method designed specifically for this setting. It uses CLIP attribution to localize editable regions and CLIP-guided diffusion inpainting to generate target features while preserving the remaining image. We consider two variants: a source-attribution mask and a source–target difference mask. Starting from a small editable region, MACE expands the mask only when needed and selects the smallest mask that changes the zero-shot prediction.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提议采用M ask-guided A daptive C unterfact E xplainments(MACE)(图1概述),这是对CLIP零发预测进行定向视觉反事实解释的方法。 据我们所知,MACE是第一个专门为这个设置设计的图像级反事实方法. 它使用CLIP属性来将可编辑区域本地化,并使用CLIP导出传播印花来生成目标特性,同时保留所剩图像. 我们考虑两种变体:源归源口罩和源-目标差口罩. 从一个可以编辑的小区域开始,MACE只在需要的时候才会扩展口罩并选择最小的口罩来改变零发预测.

blocks.en:
Across ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200, the source-mask variant achieves the highest validity, while the difference-mask variant produces the smallest image changes and the best realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over a Stable Diffusion-only baseline with the same generative backbone. We also examine how CLIP guidance strength, mask fraction, and adaptive mask expansion affect counterfactual generation in MACE.
In summary, our main contributions are: • We introduce MACE, the first image-level counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. MACE combines adaptive attribution masks, localized diffusion inpainting, and CLIP decision guidance. • We evaluate two mask variants on four datasets and show consistent gains in validity, proximity, and realism over full-image diffusion editing. • We show how CLIP guidance strength, mask fraction, and adaptive mask expansion affect counterfactual generation, providing practical insights for other diffusion-based editing methods.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work connects visual counterfactual explanations with vision–language model interpretability. We review visual counterfactual generation, CLIP explainability, CLIP-guided image editing, and counterfactual learning for vision–language models, and then explain how our method differs from these research areas.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作将视觉反事实解释与视觉-语言模型解释性联系起来。 我们检视视觉反事实生成、CLIP解释性、CLIP引导图像编辑、以及视觉-语言模型的反事实学习,然后解释我们的方法与这些研究领域有何不同。

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Counterfactual Explanations
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉反事实解释

blocks.en: Visual counterfactual explanations identify how an image should be modified to obtain a desired target prediction while preserving its original content. Early work by Goyal et al. [10] constructs counterfactuals by replacing discriminative regions of a query image with regions from a distractor image belonging to the target class. Later approaches [ 5 , 33 ] improve sparsity, semantic consistency, and visual realism through localized optimization or generative priors.
blocks.zh: 视觉反事实解释确定一个图像应如何被修改以获得理想的目标预测,同时保留其原始内容. Goyal等人的早期工作. [10]通过将查询图像的歧视性区域取而代之从属于目标类的分心者图像中取而代之来构建反事实. 后来的方法[5,33]通过局部优化或基因前传,改进了斯皮克,语义上的一致性,以及视觉现实主义.

blocks.en: Diffusion-based methods further constrain counterfactuals to the natural-image manifold. DiME [ 15 ] and DVCE [ 1 ] guide the diffusion process using classifier objectives and similarity regularization, producing realistic prediction-changing edits. Recent approaches [ 41 , 16 , 32 ] improve spatial control or reduce access requirements through object-aware editing, region-constrained generation, and black-box optimization. However, these methods are primarily designed for conventional CNN classifiers.
blocks.zh: 基于分泌的方法进一步将反事实限制在自然成像的多相上. DiME [15]和DVCE [1] 使用分级目标和相似度规范化来指导扩散过程,产生现实的预测-变化编辑. 最近的方法[41,16,32]通过有物体意识的编辑,区域限制的生成,和黑盒优化,改进空间控制或减少访问要求. 然而,这些方法主要是为CNN常规分类器设计的.

blocks.en: 2.2 CLIP Explainability
blocks.zh: 2.2 《刑法》 可解释性

blocks.en: CLIP [ 28 ] has mainly been interpreted using attribution, localization, and concept-based explanations. CLIP Surgery [ 19 ] shows that directly applying conventional CAM-style methods to CLIP can produce noisy or contradictory maps and proposes feature-level modifications for more faithful localization. Other methods explain CLIP predictions through multimodal information bottlenecks, sparse concept decompositions, or gradient-based attribution [ 37 , 3 , 44 ] .
blocks.zh: CLIP [28]主要使用归属,本地化,和基于概念的解释来解释. CLIP外科[19]显示,将常规CAM风格的方法直接应用于CLIP可以产生吵闹或自相矛盾的地图,并提议地物级修改,以更忠实地本地化. 其他方法通过多式联运信息瓶颈、概念分解或梯度归属[37、3、44]来解释CLIP预测。

blocks.en: These approaches identify image regions or concepts that contribute to image–text similarity, but they remain observational. They do not determine whether modifying the highlighted evidence is sufficient to change CLIP’s zero-shot prediction.
blocks.zh: 这些方法确定了有助于图像文本相似性的图像区域或概念,但它们仍然是观察性的。 他们无法确定修改突出显示的证据是否足以改变CLIP的零发预测.

blocks.en: 2.3 CLIP-Guided Image Editing
blocks.zh: 2.3 CLIP 引导图像编辑

blocks.en: A related line of work uses CLIP as a semantic supervision signal for image manipulation. StyleCLIP [ 24 ] and StyleGAN-NADA [ 9 ] optimize latent directions or generator parameters so that synthesized images align with target text descriptions. DiffusionCLIP [ 17 ] extends this paradigm to diffusion models, enabling text-driven edits of real images while preserving their visual identity.
blocks.zh: 相干一行采用CLIP作为图像操纵的语义监督信号. StyleCLIP [24]和StyleGAN-NADA [9] 优化潜在方向或生成器参数,使合成的图像与目标文本描述一致. 扩散CLIP [17] 将这一范式扩展至扩散模型,在保留真实图像的视觉特征的同时,允许以文字驱动编辑.

blocks.en: CF-CLIP [ 40 ] addresses limitations of direct CLIP optimization by introducing contrastive objectives that encourage more localized and semantically accurate edits . Nevertheless, these methods primarily optimize alignment with open-ended text prompts. They do not explicitly seek the smallest modification required to change the prediction of a CLIP classifier.
blocks.zh: CF-CLIP [40] 解决了直接CLIP优化的局限性,引入了可鼓励更本地化和更精准地编辑的对比目标. 尽管如此,这些方法主要是优化与开放式文本的匹配。 它们没有明确寻求改变CLIP分类器预测所需的最小修改.

blocks.en: 2.4 Counterfactual Learning for Vision–Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.4 愿景-语言模型的反事实学习

blocks.en: Counterfactuals have also been used during vision–language model training. Counterfactual Prompt Learning [ 11 ] constructs sparse feature-space counterfactuals to improve prompt generalization , while COMO [ 18 ] and CF-VLM [ 42 ] generate multimodal counterfactual examples as hard negatives to improve compositional understanding and sensitivity to semantic changes. These methods modify the training process or representation space, but they do not provide image-level explanations for individual predictions of an already trained model.
blocks.zh: 在视觉-语言模式培训中也使用了反事实。 反事实即时学习 [11] 构建了稀疏的地物-空间反事实来改进即时通化 ;而COMO [18]和CF-VLM [42] 则生成了多式反事实实例作为硬底,以增进对语义变化的构成理解和敏感性. 这些方法修改了培训过程或表示空间,但没有为已经训练好的模型的个人预测提供图像级的解释.

blocks.en: 2.5 Positioning of Our Work
blocks.zh: 2.5 我们工作的定位

blocks.en: We study visual counterfactual explanations for CLIP-based zero-shot classification. Our method operates directly in CLIP’s joint image–text embedding space and generates an explicit counterfactual image. It addresses the question: What minimal, semantically meaningful visual change is sufficient for CLIP to predict the target class instead of the source class?
blocks.zh: 我们研究基于CLIP的零发分级的视觉反事实解释. 我们的方法直接运行在 CLIP 的联合图像 - 文本嵌入空间, 并生成一个明显的反事实图像 。 它涉及以下问题: 什么样的最小,精密有意义的视觉变化,足以让CLIP预测目标类而不是源类?

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Mask-guided Adaptive Counterfactual Explanations (MACE), illustrated in Figure 1 , first determines where to edit and then how to edit to get the target class. It constructs a mask from CLIP attribution and expands it only when a strongly localized intervention fails. A latent diffusion model then inpaints the masked region under CLIP guidance while preserving the remaining image.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: To describe the experimental protocol used to evaluate MACE, we first introduce the datasets and source–target pair selection procedure, then define the metrics used to assess validity, proximity, and realism. Finally, we provide the implementation and configuration details and describe the controlled diffusion baseline used for comparison.
blocks.zh: 为了描述用于评估MACE的实验协议,我们首先引入数据集和源 - 目标配对选择程序,然后定义用于评估有效性、相近性和现实性的衡量标准。 最后,我们提供实施和配置细节,并描述用于比较的控制传播基线。

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate on ImageNet-1k [ 8 ] , Food-101 [ 6 ] , Oxford-IIIT Pet [ 23 ] , and CUB-200-2011 [ 36 ] , using the ImageNet validation split and the official test splits of the other three datasets. We include only images for which zero-shot CLIP predicts the ground-truth class as top-1 when scoring against the full dataset vocabulary using class-name prompts. For each selected image, the highest-scoring non-source class is used as the target. Because the source class is ranked first, this target corresponds to CLIP rank 2.
blocks.zh: 我们在ImageNet-1k [8],Food-101 [6],Oxford-IIIT Pet [23],和CUB-200-2011 [36]上评价,使用ImageNet验证分解和另外三个数据集的官方测试分解. 我们只包括零发CLIP预言地面真实类在用类名提示来对照完整数据集词汇打分时为上一等的图像. 对于每个被选中的图像,使用最高分的非源类作为目标. 由于源类别排名第一,这个目标对应CLIP排名2.

blocks.en:
For ImageNet, we score at most 20 validation images from each class and select the first eligible image. If none of the 20 images is eligible, that class is omitted. This produces 934 source–target pairs. For Food-101, we score 20 images and select a maximum of 10 eligible per class, producing 1,003 pairs. For Oxford-IIIT Pet, we score the full test split and select a maximum of 35 per class, producing 1,194 pairs.
For CUB-200-2011, we score all 5,794 test images against 200 bird classes and select a maximum of 10 correctly classified images per class. This produces 1,595 pairs from 186 source classes. Ablations use a separate 100-instance subset with one example from each of 100 source classes.
blocks.zh:
对于ImageNet,我们从每个类中得分最多20个验证图像,并选择第一个合格的图像. 如果20个图像中没有一个符合条件,则该类会被省略. 这产生了934个源-目标对. 对于"Food-101",我们得分20个图像,每个类最多选择10个合格,出产1,003对. 供牛津大学使用 佩特,我们得分全部测试分出,并选择每个班最多35分,产生1,194对.
对于CUB-200-2011,我们对所有5,794个测试图像进行比对200个鸟类等级的分数,并且每类最多选择10个正确的分类图像. 这从186个源类别中产生了1,595对. 分解使用一个单独的"百事"子集,从100个源类中各取一例.

blocks.en: In total, the main evaluation contains 4,726 counterfactual tasks across the four datasets. All generated counterfactuals are evaluated using the common protocol described below.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,主要评价包括四个数据集的4 726个反事实任务。 使用下文所述的共同协议对所有产生的反事实进行评价。

blocks.zh: 5.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We use Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) [ 12 ] and Kernel Inception Distance (KID) [ 4 ] between generated counterfactuals and real reference images in Inception-v3 feature space. blocks.en: 5.3 Implementation and Configuration
blocks.zh: 5.3 执行和配置

blocks.en: We use OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/16 [ 28 ] for guidance and evaluation, and to select source images that CLIP initially classifies correctly. Counterfactuals are generated with Stable Diffusion inpainting [ 29 ] 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-inpainting
blocks.zh: 我们使用OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/16 [28] 来指导和评价,并选择最初CLIP正确分类的源图像. 以平稳分化入相[29] 1 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/平稳分化-v1-5/平稳分化-平稳分化-平稳分化生成出反相.

blocks.en: We use CAV [ 7 ] as label-conditioned attribution operator in Eq. 4 to generate mask initially includes the top 25% of attribution values. If the target is not ranked first, we increase this fraction by 5% for at most 20 attempts. We keep the smallest successful mask, if none succeeds, we select the candidate with the largest target-versus-strongest-alternative margin.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 CAV [7] 作为Eq. 4 中的标签条件化的归属操作器来生成口罩,最初包括前25%的归属值. 如果目标不排在首位,我们最多增加5%。 我们保留着最小的成功口罩,如果没有成功的话,我们选择目标与最强替代优势最大的候选人。

blocks.en: 5.4 Baseline
blocks.zh: 5.4 基线

blocks.en: Because existing visual counterfactual methods [ 10 , 41 , 16 , 32 ] are designed mainly for supervised classifiers and require nontrivial adaptation to CLIP, we use a controlled Stable Diffusion baseline with the same generative backbone as our method.
blocks.zh: 由于现有的视觉反事实方法[10,41,16,32]主要是为被监督的分级者设计的,并且需要非三相适应CLIP,所以我们使用一个具有与我们的方法相同的基因骨干可控稳定分化基线.

blocks.en: Stable Diffusion-only uses the same Stable Diffusion v1.5 inpainting checkpoint 1 , resolution, denoising steps, classifier-free guidance scale [ 14 ] , seed, and target prompt, but edits the full image using only diffusion text conditioning. It uses no attribution mask or external CLIP guidance and sets inpainting strength to 1.0. The baseline is evaluated on the same source images, targets, prompts, and evaluation pipeline as our method.
blocks.zh: Stable Divusion - 仅使用同一种平稳 Divusion v1.5 涂入检查点 1 ,解析,去诺步骤,无分级制导尺度 [14],种子,以及目标快取,但只使用扩散文本调制来编辑完整图像. 它没有使用归因口罩或外部CLIP导出,并将涂入强度设置为1.0. 基线是用与我们的方法相同的来源图像、目标、提示和评价程序进行的。

blocks.en: 6 Results
blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate MACE through quantitative and qualitative comparisons with the Stable Diffusion-only baseline. We first examine validity, proximity, and realism across four datasets, and then analyze representative examples to illustrate the behavior, tradeoffs, and failure modes of the two mask variants.
blocks.zh: 我们通过定量和定性的比较,与稳定扩散的唯一基线来评估MACE。 我们首先审查四个数据集的有效性,相近性和现实性,然后分析代表性的例子,以说明两个口罩变体的行为,取舍和失败模式.

blocks.zh: 6.1 数量比较

We evaluate validity using the target top-1 success rate, proximity using normalized ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distances, LPIPS, and SSIM, and realism using FID and KID. For a fair comparison, all proximity metrics are computed on the same set of successful counterfactual examples across methods.

Stable Diffusion-only is the baseline. Lower values are better for FID, KID, and distance metrics, whereas higher values are better for validity and SSIM. Bold and underlined values indicate the best and second-best results, respectively, within each dataset and metric column.

blocks.en: Despite using the same generative backbone and target prompt as the baseline, MACE s achieves the highest validity across all four datasets. MACE d achieves the lowest normalized ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distances and LPIPS, the highest SSIM, and the best FID and KID on every dataset. Both MACE variants outperform Stable Diffusion-only on all proximity and realism metrics. Lower ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distances indicate better pixel-level preservation, lower LPIPS indicates greater perceptual similarity, and higher SSIM indicates better structural preservation. Together, these results show the benefit of mask-guided editing with CLIP guidance over full-image diffusion editing.
blocks.zh: 尽管使用了与基线相同的基因主干线和目标即时,MACEs在所有四个数据集中都取得了最高的有效性. MACE d 实现了最低的正态 I1\ell\1}和 I2\ell\2}距离和LPIPS,最高的SSIM,在每个数据集上最好的FID和KID. 两种MACE变体都优于所有相近和现实度量的平稳分泌。 下l 1\ell\1}和l 2\ell\2}相距表示更好的像素级保存,下LPIPS表示更高的知觉相近性,更高的SSIM表示更好的结构保存. 这些结果表明,在CLIP指导下,口罩制导编辑比全图像传播编辑有益处.

blocks.en: Because the proximity metrics are computed on the same set of valid counterfactuals, the consistent gains of MACE d over MACE s show that the difference mask keeps the output closer to the source image. Its lower FID and KID also indicate better realism. These gains come at the cost of lower validity, revealing a validity–proximity tradeoff. By focusing edits on regions where source evidence exceeds target evidence, MACE d may also provide a more concise explanation of the changes needed to reach the target class.
blocks.zh: 由于相近度量是在同一组有效的反事实上计算出来的,MACE d 相对于MACE s 的一贯增益表明相差面罩能使输出更接近源图像. 其较低的FID和KID也显示出更好的现实主义. 这些收益的代价是有效性较低,揭示了有效性-近似取舍。 通过将编辑的重点放在来源证据超过目标证据的区域,MACE d还可以更简明地解释达到目标类别所需的变化.

blocks.en: MACE performs strongly on general object recognition with ImageNet, food recognition with Food-101, fine-grained pet classification with Oxford Pets, and fine-grained bird classification with CUB-200. This consistency suggests that the method generalizes across class vocabularies and levels of visual granularity. In contrast, Stable Diffusion-only achieves high validity on Food-101 and Oxford Pets but performs worse on ImageNet and especially CUB-200. Text-conditioned full-image generation may capture broad target characteristics more easily than the subtle, localized cues needed to distinguish visually similar bird species.
blocks.zh: MACE在与ImageNet的通用对象识别,与Food-101的食品识别,与牛津宠物的细纹宠物分类,与CUB-200的细纹鸟类分类上都表现得强劲. 这种一致性表明,该方法将视觉颗粒度的分类词汇和水平概括起来。 相形之下,"稳定扩散"(Stable Difusion- only)在"Food-101"和"牛津宠物"(Oxford Pets)上取得了很高的有效性,但在"ImageNet"(尤其是CUB-200)上表现得更差. 与区分视觉上相近的鸟类所需的微妙、局部提示相比,文字条件齐全的图像生成可能更容易捕捉到广泛的目标特征。

blocks.en: 6.2 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 6.2 定性结果

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Qualitative comparison across ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200. Each row contains one success case on the left and one failure case on the right. For each success case, we show the source image and target class, the editable masks and counterfactuals produced by MACE s and MACE d , and the Stable Diffusion-only (SD) result. All methods reach the target class in these examples. For each failure case, we show the source image followed by the outputs of all three methods. None reaches the target class, except in the Food-101 example, where only MACE s succeeds.
blocks.zh: 图2:ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets和CUB-200之间的定性比较。 每行都收录有左侧一出成功案例和右侧一出失败案例. 对于每个成功案例,我们显示源图像和目标类,由MACE S和MACE d所出出可编辑的口罩和反事实,以及稳定扩散-只(SD)的结果. 在这些例子中,所有方法都达到了目标类. 对于每一个失败案例,我们显示所有三种方法的输出所遵循的源图像. 除了在"Food-101"的例子中只有"MACE s"获得成功外,没有达到目标等级.

blocks.en: Figure 2 qualitatively compares the results of the two MACE variants with the Stable Diffusion-only baseline. Additional qualitative results are provided in Sec. A.4 of the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 图2从质量上比较了两个MACE变体的结果和只稳定扩散基准. 补充材料第A.4节提供了其他质量结果。

blocks.en: MACE generally preserves the identity, pose, background, and composition of the source image while adding target-specific features. For example, in the grilled cheese sandwich → \rightarrow club sandwich transition, both MACE variants modify the filling while keeping the plate and surrounding objects fixed. Similarly, for Miniature Pinscher → \rightarrow Scottish Terrier, MACE introduces Terrier-specific facial and fur characteristics while maintaining the original pose, scale, and grassy background. In contrast, Stable Diffusion-only often regenerates the full image, changing the object appearance, viewpoint, and background together.
blocks.zh: MACE一般保留了源图像的特性,姿势,背景和组成,同时增加了特定目标特征. 例如,在烤起司三明治 →\右旋棒三明治过渡中,两种MACE变体都修改了填充并同时使板和周围物体固定. 类似地,对于Miniature Pinscher →\右翼苏格兰泰瑞尔,MACE引入了泰瑞尔特有的面部和皮毛特征,同时保持了原有的姿势,尺度和草本背景. 相形之下,"稳定分化"(Stable Difusion- only)往往会再生出完整的图像,将对象外观,视角和背景一起改变.

blocks.en: The two masks also produce visibly different edit sizes. MACE s often changes a broader discriminative region, whereas MACE d focuses on smaller source-specific cues. In the Cedar Waxwing → \rightarrow Bohemian Waxwing example, MACE d mainly changes the crown color, while MACE s modifies a larger part of the head. This pattern matches the quantitative tradeoff between the higher validity of MACE s and the better proximity of MACE d .
blocks.zh: 两种口罩还产生明显不同的编辑尺寸. MACEs常常改变更广泛的歧视区域,而MACEd则侧重于较小的源特定提示. 在Cedar Waxwing →\右旋波希米亚Waxwing的例子中,MACE d主要会改变花冠颜色,而MACE s则会改变大部头部. 这种模式与MACE s的更高有效性与MACE d的更相近之间的定量取舍相匹配.

blocks.en: Although the difference mask is often contained within the source mask, the generated content in their shared region may differ. Each mask starts an independent inpainting process and provides different spatial context to the diffusion model.
blocks.zh: 虽然差异口罩经常被包含在源口罩内,但其共享区域内生成的内容可能有所不同. 每个口罩会启动独立的涂装过程,为扩散模型提供不同的空间上下文.

blocks.en: Failures reflect limited masks, persistent source evidence, and missing fine-grained cues. The failure cases show three main limitations. First, MACE d may use a mask that is too small to add enough target evidence, as in French fries → \rightarrow fish and chips and Abyssinian → \rightarrow Siamese. MACE s succeeds in the Food-101 example because its larger mask allows it to add visible fish. Second, strong source evidence may remain after editing. For solar dish → \rightarrow radio telescope, both MACE variants preserve the dominant dish structure, and CLIP may view the two classes as visually similar. For Abyssinian → \rightarrow Siamese, MACE s adds blue eyes and darker facial features, but the original coat and body still support the source class. Third, fine-grained edits may look plausible but miss the exact cues needed for the target class, as seen in CUB-200. Stable Diffusion-only also fails in these cases despite making larger changes because it may generate the wrong object or class, such as fries instead of fish, a generic cat instead of a Siamese, or an off-target bird. These cases motivate larger maximum masks, stronger class-specific guidance, and prompts that describe the target’s key visual features.
blocks.zh: 失败反映了面罩有限、源头持续的证据以及缺失的精细提示。 失败案例显示有三大局限性。 首先,MACE d可能使用一个小到无法添加足够目标证据的口罩,比如在法式薯条 → 右旋鱼和薯片 和 Abysinian → 右旋暹罗. MACE s在Food-101的例子中成功,因为其更大的口罩允许它添加可见的鱼. 第二,经编辑后,强有力的来源证据可能仍然存在。 对于太阳菜 →\右旋射电望远镜来说,两种MACE变体都保留了主菜结构,而CLIP可能将这两个类视同. 对于Abyssinian →\rightarrow Siamese,MACE s增加了蓝眼睛和更深的面部特征,但原始外衣和身体仍然支持源类. 第三,精细的编辑可能看起来很合理,但错过了目标类所需的准确提示,如CUB-200所见. 稳定分泌(Stable Divusion- only)在这些情况中也失败了,尽管做了更大的改变,因为它可能会产生错误的物体或类,例如薯条代替鱼,通用猫代替暹罗,或者非目标鸟. 这些病例激发出更大的最大口罩,更强大的特定阶级指导,以及描述目标关键视觉特征的提示.

blocks.en: Stronger CLIP guidance improves validity, while mask-size effects vary by dataset. Figure 3(a) shows that stronger CLIP guidance generally improves validity across datasets and mask types, with the largest gains for the difference mask. The effect of a fixed mask fraction is more dataset-dependent. Figure 3(b) shows that larger masks strongly improve validity on Food-101, whereas the source mask on CUB-200 does not improve monotonically. Because each mask fraction produces an independent candidate rather than extending the same output, a larger mask does not always result in higher validity.

blocks.en: CLIP guidance improves measured proximity, while larger fixed masks cause larger edits. Figure 4 shows how CLIP guidance strength and mask size affect pixel-level proximity. blocks.en: Adaptive mask expansion improves validity while preserving proximity. The varying effect of mask size motivates adaptive expansion, which evaluates progressively larger masks and returns the first successful candidate. To measure its benefit, we compare the fixed mask fractions in Figures 3(b) and 4(b) with adaptive expansion up to the same maximum fractions in Figures 3(c) and 4(c) . Adaptive expansion improves validity for both mask types across datasets, with larger gains at higher maximum fractions, while maintaining much lower normalized ℓ 1 \ell_{1} distances than fixed masks at the same fractions. Results for the remaining proximity metrics are reported in Sec. A.2 of the supplementary material. By stopping at a smaller successful mask, the adaptive procedure increases the chance of finding a valid counterfactual without requiring the full edit budget.
blocks.zh: 适应性口罩扩展可以提高有效性,同时保持相近性. 口罩尺寸的不同影响刺激了适应性的扩张,它逐渐评价了更大的口罩并让第一个成功的候选人返回. 为了衡量其效益,我们将图3(b)和图4(b)中的固定口罩分数同图3(c)和图4(c)中相同的最大分数相比较。 适应性扩展提高了两种口罩类型在数据集之间的有效性,最大分数的增益较大,同时保持了比相同分数的固定口罩更低的常态l\ell\%1}距离. 其余近距离测量结果在补充材料第A.2节中报告。 通过在较小的成功口罩上停留,适应性程序增加了找到有效反事实的机会而不需要完整的编辑预算.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduced MACE, a method for generating targeted visual counterfactual explanations for CLIP zero-shot classification. MACE combines class-conditioned attribution, adaptive mask expansion, and CLIP-guided diffusion inpainting to change the model’s prediction to a target label while preserving image content outside the editable region. Experiments on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200 demonstrate the value of coupling localized editing with explicit decision guidance. The source-attribution variant achieves the highest validity across all four datasets, whereas the source–target difference variant consistently produces smaller pixel and perceptual changes and better realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over full-image Stable Diffusion editing. These results establish adaptive masking as an effective mechanism for balancing validity against source-image preservation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了MACE,一种生成目标视觉反事实解释的方法,用于CLIP零发分级. MACE结合了类有条件的归属,适应性面具扩展,以及CLIP引导的传播涂装,将模型的预测改变为目标标签,同时保留可编辑区域以外的图像内容. 在ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets和CUB-200上的实验表明,将本地化编辑与明确的决策指导结合起来是有价值的。 源属性变量在所有四个数据集中都取得了最高的有效性,而源-目标差变量则持续产生较小的像素和感官变化和更好的现实主义分数. 两种变体都比全相平稳分化编辑改进了相近性和现实性. 这些结果确立了适应性遮盖,作为平衡有效性和源图像保护的有效机制。

blocks.en: Several directions remain for future work. First, MACE currently optimizes the pairwise source–target score difference, which encourages the target class to outrank the source class but does not explicitly require it to outrank every class in the zero-shot label set. Future work could instead use a multiclass or margin-based objective that directly targets top-1 prediction. Second, because different CLIP guidance strengths and mask fractions produce distinct generations rather than incremental extensions of the same output, jointly optimizing these parameters could improve the balance between validity and preservation. Finally, future studies could apply MACE to data augmentation and robustness.
blocks.zh: 未来工作仍有若干方向。 首先,MACE目前优化了对等源-目标分数差,这鼓励了目标类排位高于源分数,但没有明确要求它排位高于零发标签集中的每一类. 未来的工作可以采用一个以多类或差值为基础的目标,直接针对头一级预测。 第二,由于不同的CLIP导取长处和遮盖分数会产生不同的代数,而不是同一输出的递增扩展,因此联合优化这些参数可以改善有效性和保存之间的平衡. 最后,今后的研究可以将MACE应用于数据增强和稳健性。
